description: This file is a source implementation for the DisplaySettings plugin in a RDK-based system. It manages display and audio settings through a variety of methods, handles IARM events related to HDMI hotplug, resolution changes, and display detection, and exposes a number of configuration and status APIs for use over a plugin framework.

classes.name: Mapping
classes.description: Structure defining mappings between IARM bus names and service manager names.
